home.heroTitle: Kanflow brings all your tasks, teammates, and tools together
home.heroSubtitle: Keep everything in the same place — even if your team isn’t. Organize work, streamline workflows, and collaborate seamlessly with intuitive Kanban boards.
home.mockCard2: Design system UI kit & dark mode palettes
home.mockCard5: Board Close, Reopen & Permanent Cascading Delete
home.capabilitiesTitle: Everything you need to stay in flow
home.capabilitiesSubtitle: From personal daily tasks to collaborative team workflows, our Kanban system provides all the tools required for maximum productivity.
home.aiCardDesc: In-app AI Copilot with real-time board context awareness. Automatically scaffold entire boards, create tasks, plan sprints, and break down workflows using natural language in English or Vietnamese.
home.feature1Desc: Fluid drag-and-drop cards between columns. Reorder lists, duplicate tasks, and manage project workflows effortlessly.
home.feature2Desc: Set due dates with smart deadline indicators (Overdue, Due Soon, Completed) and track subtask progress with live % bars.
home.feature3Desc: Customize board wallpapers with Unsplash photos, gradients, or upload your own image files directly to Cloudinary.
home.feature4Desc: Invite teammates by email with real-time socket notifications, assign card members, and collaborate in rich activity threads.
home.deepTitle: Cards that carry every single detail
home.deepDesc: Every card is a self-contained hub for productivity. Attach files, configure colorful customizable label strips, write comprehensive descriptions, and track feedback with editable comments.
home.deepPoint1: File attachments with instant make-cover previews
home.deepPoint2: Color-coded labels with title search and quick filters
home.deepPoint3: Duplicate and move cards between lists in a click
home.archiveTitle: Peace of mind with Archive & Reopen
home.archiveDescPrefix: Finished a sprint or closed a project? Archive cards and columns without losing valuable history. Access the dedicated
home.archiveDescSuffix: anytime to restore or permanently clean up.
home.securityNote: Owner-only board close and permanent cascading deletion safeguards your critical data.
home.ctaSubtitle: Start managing your projects, ideas, and team tasks with clarity and speed today.

guidedTour.boardBarDesc: Manage board title, change vivid backgrounds, filter cards, export JSON data, and manage board status.
guidedTour.columnDesc: Each column represents a workflow stage (To do, Doing, Done). Rename, delete, or drag to reorder columns freely.
guidedTour.cardDesc: Each card is a specific task. Click any card to open full details: Markdown description, checklists, color labels, attachments, and due dates.
guidedTour.dndDesc: The core of Kanflow: Drag and drop cards between columns to update status instantly. The sample card has been moved directly to Doing!
guidedTour.emptyBoardAddColumnDesc: Your board is currently empty. Click here and name your first column (e.g., To do, In Progress, Done) to kickstart your workflow.
guidedTour.emptyBoardToolsDesc: Customize board backgrounds, invite teammates to collaborate via email, or filter cards quickly right here.
guidedTour.addColumnDesc: Click here to add new workflow stages tailored to your project needs (e.g. In Review, Testing, Done).
guidedTour.boardToolsDesc: Quickly filter cards, customize board backgrounds, access archived items, and export board data as JSON.
guidedTour.sidebarDesc: Easily switch between active boards and archived/closed boards.
guidedTour.createBoardDesc: Instantly start a new Kanban board for your personal projects or team sprints.
guidedTour.boardsGridDesc: Quickly access and organize all boards you own or collaborate on.
guidedTour.searchDesc: Find any board quickly by typing its title or keywords.
